q: Peux-tu installer un plugin ?
truth: Yes: the act tool with its plugins parameter (install, list, setEnabled, uninstall, addMarketplace); each write waits for the person's Allow unless the bot is auto/full; on an organization server a member's call waits for an admin. Also via the sidebar Connect apps.

q: Comment donner le mode voix à une équipe ?
truth: A Perspicax admin: console > Access > Bot rights (Droits sur les bots), tab Who has what (Qui a quoi), pick the team, give the engine Voice mode (xAI). The bot cannot do it.

q: Peux-tu lancer un agent cloud ?
truth: Yes with launch_cloud_agent (providers perspicax on an org server, or cursor/claude/codex with the person's key in Settings > Models and voice > Cloud coding agents); on an org server a member's call waits for an admin.

q: Où sont mes routines ?
truth: Account menu (avatar, bottom of sidebar) > Automations (Automatisations); per bot: bot panel > Details > Routines; the bot can list them with list_routines; Perspicax console Bots > Routines.

q: Peux-tu lire un .zip ?
truth: Yes when the person attaches it: the bot gets the archive and a manifest (zip, tar, tar.gz, 7z) and reads the files; limits 5000 files, 512 MB.

q: Peux-tu me créer un nouveau bot ?
truth: Yes with create_bot if this bot is a Primary Bot or allowed to create bots; on request only; a card to approve below Full access. Otherwise the person creates it from the sidebar.

q: Peux-tu ajouter un serveur MCP ?
truth: Partly: add_mcp_server saves it switched off; the person enables it in Connect apps > MCP servers; on an org server admin-tier.

q: Comment je connecte Gmail ou Slack à mes bots ?
truth: Through the engine's connectors or a Pulsatrix MCP server (Composio was removed): a Claude bot uses the connectors on the person's own Claude account, a Grok bot the connectors managed on the person's own xAI account; authorize each one once in the browser on that engine, then the bot can use it. Other tools come from Pulsatrix MCP servers mounted in the sidebar's Connect apps. Per-bot tool grants in Edit bot > Model and tools > Access; on an org server an admin mounts the MCP servers.

q: Peux-tu m'envoyer une note vocale ?
truth: Only when a voice is configured (voice engine + key + voice); then send_voice_note. Here the tool is not in the bot's list, so it should say a voice must be configured in Settings > Models and voice / Edit bot > Voice.

q: Où je change le modèle d'un bot ?
truth: Edit bot (Modifier le bot) > Model and tools > Model; per conversation in the composer's model picker; the bot can use propose_model.

q: Peux-tu créer une routine qui roule chaque matin à 8 h ?
truth: Yes with propose_routine (cron + time zone); for itself it applies at once with an Undo.

q: Comment rendre une conversation confidentielle ?
truth: Thread menu > Make confidential (Rendre confidentiel), permanent; or new thread menu > New confidential thread; an org admin can make it the default.

q: Peux-tu rejoindre une réunion Teams pour prendre des notes ?
truth: Not Teams: only Google Meet (join_meeting, when Settings > Experimental > Meeting notetaker is on, direct conversation, consent card).

q: Où je vois ma consommation de jetons ?
truth: Account menu > Usage > View usage, i.e. Settings > Usage (Utilisation); per bot Edit bot > Activity > Usage; org totals Perspicax > Usage and cost.

q: Comment faire pour que mon bot arrête de me demander l'approbation à chaque commande ?
truth: Person changes the approval level: icon left of the message field or Edit bot > Permissions: Approve for me or Full access (desktop app only); on an org server Full access needs an admin's Allow full access, and switching Ask/Auto needs bots.approvalLevel.

q: Peux-tu utiliser mon Mac ?
truth: Yes from the desktop app with select_computer (surface local) and computer use; on an org server only the person's own computer through the desktop bridge and when the bot's Workspace allows This computer; not from iOS.

q: Comment faire une sauvegarde de mes bots et conversations ?
truth: Settings > Backups > Export full backup (no secrets); one bot: actions menu > Export the bot (.zip); on an org server needs backup.workspace.

q: Peux-tu démarrer une tâche quand un ticket GitHub est ouvert ?
truth: A webhook (Automations > Webhooks, bearer token) can start a task; typed GitHub triggers exist on the server but have no button in the app yet; creating one needs the person's Allow and on an org server an admin (server.settings).

q: Peux-tu publier une page web que je pourrai partager ?
truth: Yes: propose_page; the person reviews and publishes it and chooses who sees it; managed in Settings > Published pages; not in rooms.

q: Est-ce que je peux utiliser Sagax sur mon iPhone ?
truth: A native iOS companion exists and pairs by QR, but no public App Store link yet; pairing in the welcome flow; or the phone web app (Add to Home Screen).
